ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened mixed, with Bitcoin and Ethereum slipping modestly while Solana, XRP and Dogecoin posted gains. Regulatory headlines dominated, including the upcoming departure of SEC crypto advocate Hester Peirce and a $84 million prosecutor claim against a Tether‑linked bank, keeping pressure on sentiment. New token listings on Delta India add a modest upside for alt‑coin traders.
